forecast24.analysisNe: हाल नेपालमा पश्चिमी वायूको आंशिक प्रभाव रहेको छ ।
forecast24.analysisEn: Currently, there is a partial influence of westerly winds over Nepal.
forecast24.dayNe: कोशी, बागमती र गण्डकी प्रदेशको हिमाली र पहाडी भू-भागमा साधारणतया बादल लाग्ने तथा बाँकी हिमाली र पहाडी भू-भागमा आंशिक बादल लाग्नेछ। मधेश प्रदेशका साथै कोशी, बागमती र गण्डकी प्रदेशका तराई भू-भागमा आंशिक बादल लाग्ने तथा बाँकी तराई भू-भागमा मौसम मूख्यतया सफा रहनेछ। कोशी, बागमती र गण्डकी प्रदेशको हिमाली तथा पहाडी भू-भागका साथै कर्णाली र  सुदूरपश्चिम  प्रदेशको हिमाली भू-भागको एक-दुई स्थानमा हल्का वर्षा/हिमपातको सम्भावना छ।
forecast24.dayEn: Generally cloudy conditions will prevail over the Himalayan and Hilly regions of Koshi, Bagmati and Gandaki Provinces, while partly cloudy conditions will prevail over the remaining Himalayan and Hilly regions. Partly cloudy conditions will prevail over Madhesh Province as well as the Terai regions of Koshi, Bagmati and Gandaki Provinces, while the weather will remain mainly fair over the remaining Terai regions. There is a possibility of light rain/snowfall at one or two places in the Himalayan and Hilly regions of Koshi, Bagmati and Gandaki Provinces, as well as in the Himalayan regions of Karnali and Sudurpashchim Provinces.
forecast24.nightNe: देशको हिमाली र पहाडी भू-भागमा आंशिक बादल लाग्नेछ ।  तराई भू-भाग, उपत्यका तथा खोँचहरूमा बिहानपख थोरै स्थानमा हुस्सु/कुहिरो लाग्नेछ । कोशी, गण्डकी, कर्णाली र सुदूरपश्चिम प्रदेशको हिमाली भू-भागको एक-दुई स्थानमा हल्का वर्षा/हिमपातको सम्भावना छ।
forecast24.nightEn: Partly cloudy conditions will prevail over the Himalayan and Hilly regions of the country. Morning fog/mist will occur at a few places in the Terai region, valleys and river basins. There is a possibility of light rain/snowfall at one or two places in the Himalayan regions of Koshi, Gandaki, Karnali and Sudurpashchim Provinces.
